analytics.conditions: X-ray powder diffractometry, Cu-K-alpha radiation (1.54178 Angstrom), 25 deg C
analytics.raw_text: X-ray powder diffraction diagram of form A. The table at lines 95-105, repeated at 107-117, gives nine reflections as 2-theta values with their interplanar spacings d: 2-theta from 5.5 to 36.2, each stated as +/- 0.2, and d from 15.92 down to 2.48 Angstrom. The patent recites at least 3, often at least 5, in particular at least 7, and especially all nine.

notes: Crystalline form A of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form A. The section is a powder diffraction table for form A and names no other substance; the 2-theta values, spacings, radiation and wavelength are measurements and instrument settings, not compounds. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything. DOCUMENT DEFECT RECORDED, NOT REPAIRED: the description prints the first reflection as 5.5 at line 97, while claim 16 recites 5.6 for the same first reflection and the other eight values match. The description value is transcribed as printed and neither reading has been chosen.
